updates.message: Evening briefing, Nadav! Here's what matters tonight: Trump has rejected Iran's response to a US peace proposal as "totally unacceptable," putting the ceasefire under serious strain. Meanwhile, Russia is breaching its 3-day Ukraine ceasefire according to Zelenskyy. Big geopolitical tensions to keep an eye on tonight.

Good evening Nadav! A few things worth knowing tonight: Russia has breached the Ukraine ceasefire despite Trump's announcement, and the US-Iran ceasefire talks have hit a wall after Trump rejected Iran's latest proposal. It's a tense evening on the world stage.
